name: music-atlas
description: Convenience scripts for the repository root. The apps live in frontend/ and pipeline/.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && cd pipeline && uv sync
scripts.data: cd pipeline && uv run python scripts/fetch_data.py
scripts.data:check: cd pipeline && uv run python scripts/fetch_data.py --check
scripts.graph: cd pipeline && uv run python scripts/build_feature_graph.py ../data/derived
scripts.atlas: cd pipeline && uv run python scripts/run.py pilot
scripts.check: cd pipeline && uv run pytest && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
